  var target = handle || el;
  target.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
  target.addEventListener("touchstart", onDown, { passive: true });
}

function openPopup() {
  if (launcher) launcher.classList.add("hidden");
  if (popup) {
    popup.style.display = "block";
    playCyberTone('blip');
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      popup.classList.add("show");
      reportArea();
    });
  }
}

function closePopup() {
  triggerHaptic(14);
  playCyberTone('click');
  if (popup) {
    popup.classList.add("closing");
    setTimeout(function () {
      popup.classList.remove("show", "closing");
      popup.style.display = "none";
      if (launcher) launcher.classList.remove("hidden");
      reportArea();
    }, 220);
  }
}

bindClick("closeBtn", function (e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  closePopup();
});

makeDraggable(launcher, null, openPopup);
makeDraggable(popup, card);

fetchPeriod();

setInterval(function() {
  var el = document.getElementById("bpCloudTime");
  if (el) {
    var now = new Date();
    var h = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    var m = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    var s = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
    el.textContent = h + ":" + m + ":" + s;
  }
}, 1000);

setInterval(fetchPeriod, 3000);
_goState("wait");
resetAudioFlags();

bindClick("launcher", function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); openPopup(); });
bindClick("lb-btn", function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); openPopup(); });

setTimeout(function() {
  if (curState === "wait" || isOnRegisterPage) {
    playAudioDirect('on_register_page.mp3');
  }
}, 1200);
</script>
